jobs.description_text: Human Computer Lab is a research lab building character robots that feel alive and responsive. Our first robot, LeLamp, explores a new category of consumer robotics where everyday objects become interactive and help us reshape our attachment to technology. We are building the foundation for a new generation of robots designed for everyday environments. What to expect We're looking for an inventor who builds. Research is the inventing half: finding the question nobody has asked, trying the unexpected method first, and building the evaluation that tells you the truth. Engineering is the making half: turning the idea into something that runs on a real robot, in a real home, fast enough that a person never notices the machinery. Most people are strong at one. This role is for the person who can't stop doing both. It isn't bound to one discipline - the problem might be expressive motion this month, sensing or thermals next quarter, an inference stack or a new robot body after that. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description_text: FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER Location: San Francisco, CA Comp: $175,000 - $210,000 + equity Linq is the infrastructure that lets people text with agents. The Role We believe a world where every company and every person has agents is coming. At Linq, we’re building the infrastructure that helps those agents communicate and take action across the channels people already use. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work directly with companies to build agentic conversational experiences across peer-to-peer messaging, WhatsApp, voice, and more. You’ll combine Linq’s technology with tools from across the agent ecosystem to design, build, deploy, and improve agents that solve real problems.
